description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Web shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrders" name="Initial parts orders"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatches" name="Further parts batches"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Order from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Order from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, prices and delivery times"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Select the cheapest parts and allocate orders across shops if needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build the contract project"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Event_LaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives"
                        attachedToRef="Task_BuildProject" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:documentation>Further batches may arrive in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BatchAdded" name="Batch added to stock"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockThresholds" name="Check stock for a single part"
                           default="Flow_Stock_NoAction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" name="Join applicable stock responses"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockResponses" name="Stock responses completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Lists" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_AddStock" sourceRef="Event_LaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddStock_EndBatch" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="End_BatchAdded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Thresholds" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_BelowFive" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_BelowThree" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Join" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" targetRef="End_StockResponses"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
